alerts.title: TDF renal monitoring may be overdue
alerts.message: Guidelines require serum creatinine and eGFR every 12 months for experienced patients on TDF. The patient's most recent creatinine was 76 umol/L on 2025-12-15 (38 days ago), which is within normal range. However, no eGFR was recorded alongside this creatinine result. If the prior creatinine was performed at intake in 2022, the next 12-month monitoring may be due or overdue depending on exact prior dates. The clinician's plan does not include renal monitoring.

evidence.recommended_action: Confirm last creatinine/eGFR date. If >12 months ago, order serum creatinine and eGFR at this visit per TDF monitoring guidelines.

alerts.title: Viral load monitoring frequency gap
alerts.message: Guidelines state viral load should be measured 6 months after ART initiation and every 6-12 months or when clinically indicated. The patient's latest viral load was 20 copies/mL on 2025-09-15, approximately 4 months before this visit, which is within the acceptable 6-12 month interval. No viral load is due at this encounter. The clinician's plan does not mention viral load, which is appropriate given the recent test.

evidence.recommended_action: No action needed now. Schedule next viral load by March 2026 to stay within 12-month interval.
